note: Czasy orientacyjne. Aktualny przebieg i punktację sprawdź w informatorze CKE.

criteria.label: Realizacja zadania
criteria.hint: Odnoszę się do wszystkich elementów i rozwijam odpowiedzi.

criteria.label: Zakres środków językowych
criteria.hint: Różne struktury i słownictwo, nie tylko podstawowe.

criteria.label: Poprawność
criteria.hint: Mało błędów, które przeszkadzają w zrozumieniu.

questions: What do you usually do after school?
Tell me about something interesting you did last weekend.
Would you rather spend a free day at home or outdoors? Why?

cards.situation: Jesteś w Londynie na wymianie. Chcesz pójść ze znajomym z Anglii (egzaminator) na koncert. Rozmawiacie o planie.
examinerLines: Hi! So, you said you wanted to go to a concert this weekend?
Hmm, I'm not a big fan of that kind of music. What else could we see?
Tickets in London can be really expensive. How much do you want to spend?
How are we going to get there? It finishes quite late.
And what about afterwards? Any ideas?

cards.description: A family of four is cooking together in a small, bright kitchen. The father is cutting vegetables, the mother is reading a recipe on a tablet, and two teenagers are setting the table and laughing. There is a large pot on the cooker and a bowl of salad on the counter. Through the window you can see that it is raining.
questions: Why do you think the family decided to cook together?
Tell me about a time when you cooked something for other people.
Do you think young people today know how to cook? Why?
usefulPhrases: In the picture I can see …

cards.situation: Twoja klasa wybiera miejsce jednodniowej wycieczki na koniec roku szkolnego.
options: A group of students hiking on a mountain trail with a guide.
Students in a science centre trying interactive experiments.
Teenagers kayaking on a quiet river on a sunny day.
criteria: Wybierz miejsce, które będzie najlepsze dla całej klasy, i uzasadnij swój wybór.
questions: Why is it important for classmates to spend time together outside school?
Tell me about the most memorable school trip you have been on.
